en.t: In this way two or three days passed.

units.source_text: 不用说，在这两三天中，对K的担心萦绕在我的心头，沉重不堪。

en.t: Needless to say, during those two or three days my anxiety about K weighed heavily on my heart.

units.source_text: 我心想，自己若不想法做点什么，便对不起他。

en.t: I felt that if I did not find some way to do something, I would be failing him.

units.source_text: 而且看夫人的样子和小姐的神情，又像是刺激着我这么做似的，使我愈加坐卧不宁。

en.t: Moreover, the way Madam behaved and the young lady looked seemed to urge me on, making me more and more restless.

units.source_text: 男人般性情爽快的夫人说不定什么时候就会在饭桌上把这件事捅给K，

en.t: Madam, with her frank, almost masculine temperament, might at any moment blurt the matter out to K at the dining table,

units.source_text: 而且也不能断言，从那以来小姐对我日渐明显起来的亲昵态度，不会成为使K心生疑窦的原因。

en.t: and I could not say for certain that the young lady's increasingly obvious affection toward me since then would not become a cause of suspicion in K's mind.

units.source_text: 眼下的处境使我必须想个办法，把我和这个家庭之间结成的新关系告诉K。

en.t: The situation now forced me to find some way to tell K about the new relationship that had been formed between me and this family.

units.source_text: 可是由于自己在伦理道德上有理亏之处，对于一向自负的我而言，更是难上加难的事。

en.t: But because I knew I was morally in the wrong, this was all the more difficult for someone as proud as I was.

units.source_text: 无奈之下，我打算请夫人正式对K说一下，当然是趁我不在家的时候。

en.t: With no other choice, I thought of asking Madam to tell K formally, of course when I was not at home.

units.source_text: 不过，若是对他实话实说，那么只有直接与间接的区别，在丢脸上没有什么不同。

en.t: However, if she told him the truth, the only difference would be whether it was direct or indirect; the shame would be no different.

units.source_text: 然而，若要夫人编假话，夫人必定会追问我为什么要这样了。

en.t: Yet if I asked Madam to invent a lie, she would certainly press me for the reason.

units.source_text: 如果把一切都告诉夫人，我就必须主动把自己的弱点暴露在自己的爱人和她母亲面前。

en.t: If I told Madam everything, I would have to expose my own weakness of my own accord before my beloved and her mother.

units.source_text: 一向正直本分的我，认为这关乎我未来的信誉，

en.t: Being by nature earnest and proper, I felt that this concerned my future credibility,

units.source_text: 在结婚之前就失去爱人的信任的话，哪怕是一丝一毫，对我而言也无异于无法忍受的不幸。

en.t: and to lose even the slightest measure of my beloved's trust before marriage seemed to me an unbearable misfortune.
